title: AD-LLM: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Anomaly Detection

layout.note: Three rounded task cards side by side, each titled above, with a dashed grey LLM box on their left. One wide horizontal band crosses the cards at mid height and ends in a large arrowhead; every card puts its input above the band and its output below, joined by block arrows. The augmentation card is split into two sub-columns by a dashed line.

lesson: State several tasks of one model with a single shared band for the model and colour-coded cards that put each input above and each output below, so the figure reads as task definitions instead of architecture. Pair every input and output with a stock icon and a short caption, and use plus signs for composite outputs.
